title: MP CM Helpline 181
benefits: Lodge complaints regarding non-performance or delay in state government services
Automatic multi-tier escalation to Senior Officers if unresolved
application_process: Step 1: Dial 181 from any mobile or landline
Step 2: Describe the issue to the operator or follow IVR instructions
Step 3: Receive SMS ticket ID for tracking online via cmhelpline.mp.gov.in
important_sections_or_clauses: Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewaon Ke Pradan Ki Guarantee Adhiniyam, 2010
